updates.title: Reported: 700 diverted via Church Road
updates.summary: A passenger saw an eastbound 700 running via Church Road in Hove on 25 September.
updates.body:
A passenger reported a 700 diverting via Church Road, seen in Hove at about 14:32 on Thursday 25 September 2026.

It isn't a one-off: several 700 buses heading east towards Brighton have been seen taking the same diversion before the Westbourne Villas stop. We haven't seen it westbound.

This is a single report from the live bus view. We haven't confirmed it with Stagecoach, and it doesn't say why buses are being diverted or for how long.
